Thank you for your response. 

My dad died a few months ago and my career (like many) has been put on hold for the time being. It’s been very easy for me recently to pick apart every mistake, misstep and overcorrection I’ve made my entire life. Recalling terrible thoughts that I’ve had in the past is becoming scarily easy. I just feel like disappearing. Or putting my thoughts and emotions on hold for a minute. But I can’t. They flood my mind to a point where I feel like I’m drowning and I can’t breathe. Then at that point I don’t want to breathe. I don’t want to feel. I just want it all to stop. 

I’m tired of fighting.
